svg.title: Sequence Diagram for Spendly Spending Insight Generation

g.text: Sequence Diagram for Spendly Spending Insight Generation
Retrieve active user, transactions and budgets
Prompt user to add or import transactions
Aggregate weekly totals and prepare features
Predict next 7 days of total spending
Evaluate forecast, budgets, alerts and changes
Store AnalysisRun, Forecast, alerts and recommendations
